title: Balance of Digital and Physical Controls
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the vehicle’s logical layout and the balance between digital and analog or physical controls, while one fragment reports a customer view without a clearly attributable sentiment toward the vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the logical layout and the mix of analog, digital, and physical controls as well judged.

undetermined.summary: One undetermined review relays a customer statement about an ideal balance of digital and physical controls without a clearly direct evaluative voice from the reviewer.

limitations: The topic is based on very few fragments, so examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions.
One fragment is undetermined because it paraphrases a customer view rather than providing a clearly attributable direct review sentiment.
